title: The Wow signal

tellings.quote: like the famous Wow signal discovered by Gerry Eman at Ohio State,
In August, a radio [music] telescope in Ohio caught the WOW signal
tellings.difference: Gives the month as August and does not name the discoverer.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1977 Wow signal picked up by the Ohio radio telescope.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls the famous Wow signal, a radio signal that he says a radio telescope at Ohio State University picked up in August 1977, and that he credits to an astronomer named Gerry Ehman. It is told as a possible message from beyond Earth. If true, it would mean someone out there was sending signals.
